tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro nai gu'i dbang bka' che chung rnams kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i chos bcu dang lngar dbye ba'i khyad par bzhugs/
༄༅/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro nai gu'i dbang bka' che chung rnams kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i chos bcu dang lngar dbye ba'i khyad par bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro nai gu'i dbang bka' che chung rnams kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i chos bcu dang lngar dbye ba'i

khyad par bzhugs/ na mo gu ru/ ye shes mkha' 'a gro nai gu ma nas brgyud pa'i dbang bka' che chung rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i sngon 'gro rnam pa bcu dang*/ lnga'i dbye ba bshad par bya ste/ de la sngon 'gro bcu ni bsam pa 'chos pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ spro ba bskyed nas/ de rjes gsol ba btab pa/ gnang pa sbyin pa dang*/ nyan par gdams pa dang*/ yan lag lnga pa bya zhing*/ sdom pa bzung ba/ gsang ba bsgrags te ye shes dbab pa'o/ /'di la bsam pa 'chos pa yan lag tu btang nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed so sor bgrang bas bcur byed pa'i skabs kyang yod mod don gcig go /yig rnying 'ga' zhig na/ spro ba bskyed pa med par/ gzeng bstod dang*/ gsang ba bsgrags pa so sor byed pa'ang yod do/ /'dir 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa'i yi ge ltar byas te/ de la dang po bsam pa 'chos pa ni/ da res rang re rnams kyi rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor kyi mi lus rin po che thob/ mjal bar dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang dgos su sngags kyi theg pa zab mo dang mjal ba'i skabs 'dir chos la 'bad na bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyang bsgrub par dka' ba min na/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun tshogs gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ 'on kyang da res chos la ma 'bad na/ phyis mi lus thob pa tsam yang rnyed dka'/ mi lus ma thob na chos byed pa'i skal ba med/ chos ma byas na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las grol ba mi srid/ mi lus lan gcig thob pas phan pa yang min gyis/ nges par 'chi/ myur du 'chi/ nam 'chi cha med 'chi ba la cis kyang mi phan/ shi nas khungs med du song na ta kho rang shes te/ da lta'i dgra gnyen longs spyod tshe 'di'i snang ba kun dang bral yang sems khungs med du mi 'gro/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa rnams tshe 'di'i longs spyod bzhin shul tu spangs pa mi 'dod/

las kyi dbang gis rigs drug gang rung du skye ba las 'os med/ gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin kho na yin*/ sdug bsngal de yang zad mi shes shing thar bar dka' ba rgya mtsho dang mtshungs pa bzhin 'dug pa las/ nges par thar dgos par 'dug /rang gcig pu thar bas mi phan gyis sems can thams cad thar dgos pa 'dug snyam pa'i 'dun pa mdzod/ / ces brjod/ gnyis pa skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed gnyis kyi skyabs 'gro ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung nas/ ji srid snying por byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes lan gsum/ gnyis pa sems bskyed la gnyis kyi/ smon pa sems bskyed ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas da lta la thug gi bar du sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang*/ sgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgya bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis ji ltar thugs rin po che skyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung nas/ snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyid do/

/sems can ma sgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /ma grol pa rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o/ /dbugs ma dbyungs ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o/ / zhes lan gsum/ gnyis pa 'jug pa sems bskyed ni/ dgongs gsol gong bzhin/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung nas ji srid snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mthar gyis bslabs pa dang*/ mthar gyis sbyangs pa dang*/ mthar gyis bsgrubs par bgyi'o/ /de bzhin du tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnams la mthar gyis bslabs pa dang*/ mthar gyi sbyangs pa dang*/ mthar gyis bsgrub par bgyi'o/ / gsum pa spro ba bskyed pa ni/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug par bya/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan ni 'jig rten pha rol gnyer/ /dad pa chen po ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa gzhug bya ste/ /tshe 'di'i 'bras bu gnyer mi bya/ / bdag don tshe 'dir gnyer byed na/ /gzhan don sangs rgyas ga la byung*/ / 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na/ /'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ / bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab pa ni/ thog mar slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul te/ tshigs lhug pa rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba zhig gis maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i rjes la/ bkod pa shin tu legs pa'i maṇ+ḍal mchog / zhes sogs brjod/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ / sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/

/ skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ / mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ / zhes lan gsum/ lnga pa gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ / gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di/ khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*/ /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*/ /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams/ /de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bo byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med des/ /ye shes mnyam med thob pas na/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas he ru kas/ /bdud ni shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig / ces brjod la don bshad do/ /drug pa rtog pa bsdu ba ni/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang po'i sems kyis nyon/ /brjed nges blo la he ru ka sogs dang*/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlobs// zhes brjod la don bshad do/ /bdun pa yan lag lnga pa bya ba ni/ bdag gi sdig pa bgyis pa dang*/ /bgyid rtsal rjes su yi rang gang*/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /de dag bdag gis bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyis/ /sgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams kyi/ / tshogs la bdag ni yi rang ngo/ /sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji ltar bar/ / skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed ltar/ /de bzhin bdag ni sems bskyed do/ /bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/

/ 'jig rten 'dir ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos ni ston bgyid cing*/ /sems can sdug bsngal mang po gzir las sgrol/ / zhes lan gsum/ brgyad pa sdom pa 'bogs pa ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /ji tsam dus nas bzung nas su/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po la/ /yongs su gnas pa'i bar dag tu/ /bdag gis byang chub mchog gi sems/ /ma lus par ni skyed par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/ /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*/ / sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te bzung bar bgyi/ nam du yang ni mi spang ngo/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yis/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /spyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu spyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*/ /ma grol ba ni dgrol bar bgyi/ /ma bsgral ba ni bsgral bar bgyi/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ / ces brjod/ dgu pa gzengs bstod cing gsang ba bsgrags pasogs ni/

'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /u dam wa ri'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni re 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung srid/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ / de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gnyis med zab mo'i spyod yul 'dis/ /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas byed/ /gang gis bskal pa bye ba ru/ /sdig pa'i las rnams byas pa yang*/ /zab mo'i dkyil 'khor 'di mthong bas/ /de dag thams cad byang gyur nas/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos*/ /gang gi bskal ba dpag med du/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags kyang*/ /'di ni rnyed pa shin tu dka'/ /de bas 'di la dga' bar gyis/ / zhes brjod/ de nas gsang ba bsgrags pa ni/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du dri bzang gis thig le byas/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūṃ/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis lus gang bas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag par gyur/ snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta u pa ta ya mi/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ su ra ta sa ma ya stam/ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje mgo bor gzhag la/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis/ /sangs rgyas sku ru khyod 'grub cing*/ /mi phyed ye shes thob par 'gyur/ / rdo rje snying gar bzhag la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smra na ni/ /de ma thag tu gral te gshegs/ / bdud rtsi lnga yis chu blud la/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ badz+ra sarba pañca amṛ ta u ta ka hūṃ/

yang rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyi/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nga yin gyi/ /nga yi je ltar bka' stsal pa/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis nyan par gyis/ /gal te nga la brnyas na ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brnyas pa yin/ /mi bde ma spangs dus byas nas/ /dmyal ba chen por 'gyur ta re/ / bcu pa ye shes dbab par gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /bdag la byin gyis rlobs mdzod la/ /rdo rje ye shes bla med ni/ /da lta nyid du dbab tu gsol/ / ces pa'am/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /byin gyis brlab pa'i ye shes mchog /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /gtso bos bdag la stsal du gsol/ / zhes pa gang rung gis lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ sngon 'gro bcu ni de rnams yin la/ ye shes dbab pa ni/ so so la cung zad mi 'dra ste/ spos dang rol mo'i sgra bya ste/ sgyu lus dbang mo che'i ye shes dbab pa la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i lha tshogs rnams dang*/ bla ma rdo rje he ru ka mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams las de dang 'dra ba'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byung khyod rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs lus gang lus sems bde bas khyab par gyur/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad dang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi lha tshogs sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab pa tsam spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib sib thim par mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la/ spos phul/ rol chen dbab/ rgyud sde lnga dang rnal 'byor ma dang*/ mgon po'i snying po dang*/ na mo bud+dha ya 'i sngags rnams kyi mthar/ ā be sha ya a āḥ

zhes btags la ye shes 'bebs/ tiṣ+tha badz+ra sogs ni 'di rnams la mi dgos/ 'di rnams kyis gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre/ bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang bzhi lus bsgres su grags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang dang 'pho ba'i dbang mo che dang*/ chos dug so so'i sgos bka' dang*/ phyag chen bka' lnga/ mkha' sbyod bka' lnga/ gzhan yang rgyud sde lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bka' sogs phal che ba zhig la/ sgyu lus dbang mo che 'di kha 'don pa spo bas chog ste/ mdun bskyed gang bskyed ba de dang 'dra ba'i lha tshogs spros nas slob ma'i spyi bor bstim pa dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang bdun bskyed kyi lha rnams dang rnam pa mthun par spyan drangs te/ lus kyi cha thams cad nas bstim/ mdun bskyed la ji ltar bskyed pa'i lha de'i sngags la a be sha btags pas 'bebs/ sgyu lus dbang mo che'i dbang chog las ye shes 'bebs pa'i skabs mig dar bcings par gsung na'ang*/ lag len la mi mdzad do/ /bsdus pa sngon 'gro lnga pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs/ rgyun bshags bya/ zla ba rdor sems bskyed pa dang*/ mna' chu blud pa'i dam bzhag dang*/ gsol ba btab nas ye shes 'bebs pa rnams yin te/ yig rnying rnams la dbang bka' thams cad la sngon 'gro bcu pa 'di byed par gsung pas/ de bzhin lcogs na bzang ba'o/ /dngos gzhi'i cho ga shin tu bsdus pa la sngon 'gro rgyas pa de mi mdzes pas phyag len la bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang rgyas pa dang*/ sgyu lus dbang mo che la sngon 'gro bcu pa 'di mdzad cing*/ gzhan rnams la sngon 'gro lnga pa 'di mdzad na/ dgos don 'grub pas shin tu legs so/ kho bo cag gi bla ma dam pa don la sangs rgyas dang gnyis su med cing*/ tshul ston du yang rdzogs rim gyi man ngag rtsoms pa la mkhyen pa rgyas pa dang*/

bye brag tu yang gdams pa 'di'i skor la thos bsam sgom pa'i nyams myong phyag len de rnam pa lnga'i sgo nas rang byan chud pa de nyid kyi phyag len bzhin du bdag gis 'khum pa lags/ gzhan deng sang chos 'di'i skor la mkhas par grags shing mkhas par rlom pa 'ga' la'ang lag len oṃ so las mi gda'o// //sngon 'gro'i yig chung bsdus pa 'di yang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /sarba mad+ga lam/ dge legs 'phel/ 'di bris dge bas las sgrib dag gyur cig /bkra shis bde legs/ /
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 200 -- PAGE 201 -- PAGE 192 -
